# A clean gate file

Prose before the first question is free.

## Group

### demo.cta-script
- applies-when: web-surface and has-cta; the main call to action
- question: Is the call to action wholly on the first screen at every width?
- answered-by: script
- writes: layout
- yields-to: level 1
- source: a made-up brief; strength: house judgement
- era: timeless
- owner: demo

### demo.cta-look
- applies-when: web-surface or social; the main call to action

- question: Does the call to action read as the one thing to do?
- answered-by: look
- writes: layout
- yields-to: demo.cta-script, level 6
- source: a made-up brief; strength: house judgement
- era: dated 2027-02-28
- owner: demo

### demo.any
- applies-when: any; the whole asset
- question: Is it finished?
- answered-by: code
- writes: state
- yields-to: none
- source: a made-up brief; strength: house judgement
- era: timeless
- owner: demo
